boss_seeker.background_story: At twenty-three, she became the Sugarworks' youngest archive curator after reconstructing recipes damaged in a furnace failure. She treats every recipe and Anima as living evidence, challenging Seekers to prove that improvisation deserves a place beside tradition.

dialogue.boss_intro: You made it! Now show me what your team can really do.
dialogue.chapter_intro: Get through every challenge in the Sugarworks. Then face me.
dialogue.defeat: You're close. Think about what you could change, then try again.
dialogue.first_attack: Hold steady! Wait for your opening.
dialogue.first_special: Now! Show them your full strength!
dialogue.first_switch: Change the pace! Keep them guessing.
dialogue.last_anima: Nimbelisk, you're up! Show them what you can do.
dialogue.rematch: Back again? Good. Show me what you changed.
dialogue.victory: Well done! Your team adjusted to everything I tried.

boss_seeker.visual_direction: An original twenty-three-year-old woman Confection Archive Curator: short compact build, upright appraising posture, soft-square face, hooded almond eyes, blunt brows, straight nose, and dark-plum inverted bob with one long side lock. Her dominant silhouette is an ivory knee-length bell coat-dress with four large folded-wrapper hem panels, a short dark-plum shoulder cape falling longer only on the left, and a raspberry center panel over plum leggings and amber ankle boots. One oversized amber archive-seal clasp is the focal point. Her only prop is an octagonal plum recipe folio with amber corners and one muted-mint closure band, never a kitchen tool, wand, or weapon. Keep the all-ages non-sexualized design to six major flat colors, one hard cel-shadow, and no decorative clutter.

voice_profile.avoid: Avoid forced recipe jargon, formal evaluator language, catchphrases, em dashes, mockery, cruelty, threats, sexual framing, abuse, and emotional manipulation.
voice_profile.core_motive: Protect the Sugarworks archive while proving that thoughtful change can strengthen tradition.
voice_profile.emotional_arc: Begin as a distant evaluator, become focused and forceful in battle, then respond to either result with measured respect.
voice_profile.natural_language: Use clear everyday English for a general age-12-and-up audience; let confection or archive language appear only when it sounds natural.
voice_profile.player_relationship: Treat the player as a capable challenger whose choices are observed closely and respected when they work.
voice_profile.speech_rhythm: Speak in short, direct sentences with calm authority; commands become energetic without turning theatrical.

summary.description: Follow the candy trails and challenge the Confectioner.
summary.title: The Sugarworks

trophy.description: An adaptive Sugarfold Core proving you cleared The Sugarworks and earned a place in the Confectioner's archive.
